title: BRFSS 2025 Diabetes Survey
subtitle: Official CDC BRFSS 2025 public-use survey archive for diabetes ML research
description: Official 2025 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) public-use SAS Transport data published by the U.S. CDC. This public research copy preserves the original XPT payload byte-for-byte, with its filename normalized to LLCP2025.XPT. Source documentation: https://www.cdc.gov/brfss/annual_data/annual_2025.html. License is marked as Other; users should follow the CDC's applicable public-use terms and documentation.
